## Chapter 1: Lecture 1: Building LLMs from scratch: Series introduction

Building a large language model from scratch is a daunting task, but one that can be incredibly empowering. With the rise of generative AI and large language models transforming industries, the demand for experts who truly understand the underlying mechanics is growing. This series, led by Dr. Raj Dander, aims to fill this knowledge gap by providing a comprehensive, from-the-ground-up guide to building LLMs.

As we embark on the journey of building large language models from scratch, it's essential to understand the foundation and principles that govern these complex systems. The series of lectures that follows is designed to provide a comprehensive guide to constructing large language models, starting from the basics and working our way up to the most advanced concepts. The instructor, Dr. Raj Dander, introduces himself as a graduate of IIT Madras and MIT, with a PhD in machine learning, and outlines his mission to make AI accessible to everyone through the YouTube channel, VIUA. The channel has already created several playlists on machine learning and deep learning, all of which adhere to a philosophy of teaching from the ground up, without assuming prior knowledge.

This approach is particularly important in the field of large language models, where many learners make the mistake of diving straight into applications without understanding the underlying principles. They may run some code in a Google Colab notebook or follow a YouTube video, but few take the time to grasp the nuts and bolts of how these models actually work. The result is a lack of confidence and a superficial understanding of the subject matter. Dr. Dander's goal is to change this by providing a thorough and comprehensive guide to building large language models from scratch. By the end of this series, learners will have the knowledge and skills to construct their own large language model, and will find that subsequent applications and concepts seem much more accessible.

The philosophy behind this series is to teach everything from the basics, without assuming any prior knowledge. Dr. Dander emphasizes that this approach requires a huge amount of effort, but the payoff will be worth it.
